question: Oda-sensei! If you don't want your urchin packed into sushi, answer this question! On p. 65 of Chapter 360 in Volume 38, Zoro is stuck in the chimney. But if he slipped up there, he would either fall off the side or go in feet-first, I think. So how did he get jammed in there like a sea anemone??
answer: First of all, Zoro got knocked out of the Galley-la headquarters into the sea by Lucci. After he got out of the water, soaking wet, what could have happened to him? Zoro: "Shit, I got tossed pretty damn far." "Where am I now?" "All right, I'll take a look from that chimney up there." -"Humph." "Yikes, I almost fell INTO the chimney." "Man, that hole goes in deep." "Let's take a bit of a look-see." "Hmmmm" "Slip" "Thwup!!"
name: Mahito
